newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Pertamina imports 11.4 mln kl products in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: Pertamina imports 11.4 mln kl products in 1996/97.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company Pertamina said on Monday it imported 11.4 million kilolitres of fuel products and 71.5 million kl crude oil in fiscal 1996/97 (April-March).
"I think the imports in 1997/98 will be the same as we have imported in 1996/97," Baharuddin, Pertamina's general affairs director, told Reuters.
Pertamina's processing director Godfried Atihuta said Pertamina's refineries produced 37.9 million kilolitres of fuel products, while consumption was 49.3 million kilolitres in 1996/97.
"I think the consumption will increase, but the refineries will produce almost the same," he said.
"We really need a new oil refinery with at least 125,000 barrels-per-day capacity to meet growing domestic demand," he said.
